q: You have read an AI summary of a topic and want to genuinely own the material. What does the lesson advise?
options: Read the summary twice to memorise it
Summarise the summary for a friend
Move straight on to the next topic
Ask AI to quiz you and check your answers
explanation: Explanations make you understand; questions make you own the material. Getting it wrong in a private chat costs nothing — if you can answer the questions, you know it; if you can't, you know exactly what to reread.

q: You want to move into data analysis. What is the lesson's recommended first step?
options: Enrol on the most popular course immediately
Ask for a skill map, then turn it into a 30-day plan with milestones
Ask AI to do the analysis for you
Read a single article about the field
explanation: Ask for the five core skills, what to learn in what order and how to prove each, then turn the map into a 30-day plan with weekly milestones and a visible finish. AI is the guide; the milestones are yours.

q: An AI explanation still confuses you. What does the lesson suggest you do?
options: Give up — the topic is beyond you
Find a harder explanation to challenge yourself
Keep pushing: ask for simpler terms, a real example, and where it matters in your job
Memorise the explanation despite not understanding it
explanation: Tutor mode adjusts to your level and you keep pushing — 'simpler', 'give me a real example', 'where does this actually matter in my job?' — because this tutor is happy to explain the same thing five different ways.
